| forum.data.0006 | Additive master extension > 5. mandatory technical baseline | database transactions | persistence | 3 | high | implemented | verified | The additive Schema Builder migration preserves populated vote, reaction, and moderation rows while adding portable fixed-value constraints, optimistic case versioning, a unique nullable closure request key, and query-driven indexes; ForumVoteValue and PhotoReactionType provide backed enum casts; raw invalid values and direct duplicate vote/reaction writes are rejected by SQLite constraints; CloseForumModerationCase authorizes before and after its row lock, checks the expected version, treats the same request key as an idempotent replay, rejects stale competing closure, and commits case state plus bounded report events atomically; AcceptForumAnswer keeps the canonical accepted_answer_id synchronized when a competing single-answer selection replaces the previous answer; The focused database-correctness contract passed 12 tests and 74 assertions; the complete sequential repository suite passed 2,303 tests and 76,109 assertions; Fresh isolated SQLite verification passed 117 migrations and 196 tables; repeated seeding preserved the user count at 5; Full Pint and Larastan passed with zero findings; Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite 8.2.0 production build, and config/event/route/view cache compilation passed; The immutable source check and deterministic 38,377-requirement generation passed for checksum cbb7d3a36f3750106c4751191ddd7d882d922ce0ae0e0b12aed318c809206ea1; The loopback Chrome gate passed EN/LT/RU account entry and authenticated forum, content, pet, medical, social, community, settings, translation, and administration surfaces from 320px through 1920px with no overflow, unnamed controls, invalid images, duplicate IDs, raw keys, or console errors |
| forum.data.0007 | Additive master extension > 5. mandatory technical baseline | database constraints | persistence | 3 | high | implemented | verified | The additive Schema Builder migration preserves populated vote, reaction, and moderation rows while adding portable fixed-value constraints, optimistic case versioning, a unique nullable closure request key, and query-driven indexes; ForumVoteValue and PhotoReactionType provide backed enum casts; raw invalid values and direct duplicate vote/reaction writes are rejected by SQLite constraints; CloseForumModerationCase authorizes before and after its row lock, checks the expected version, treats the same request key as an idempotent replay, rejects stale competing closure, and commits case state plus bounded report events atomically; AcceptForumAnswer keeps the canonical accepted_answer_id synchronized when a competing single-answer selection replaces the previous answer; The focused database-correctness contract passed 12 tests and 74 assertions; the complete sequential repository suite passed 2,303 tests and 76,109 assertions; Fresh isolated SQLite verification passed 117 migrations and 196 tables; repeated seeding preserved the user count at 5; Full Pint and Larastan passed with zero findings; Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite 8.2.0 production build, and config/event/route/view cache compilation passed; The immutable source check and deterministic 38,377-requirement generation passed for checksum cbb7d3a36f3750106c4751191ddd7d882d922ce0ae0e0b12aed318c809206ea1; The loopback Chrome gate passed EN/LT/RU account entry and authenticated forum, content, pet, medical, social, community, settings, translation, and administration surfaces from 320px through 1920px with no overflow, unnamed controls, invalid images, duplicate IDs, raw keys, or console errors |

_forum.scss and ResponsiveInterfaceTest: 44px forum controls, visible summary focus, readable media disclosures, reduced-motion and forced-colors contracts, non-color statuses, and WCAG AA critical color-pair assertions including the corrected 4.91:1 muted text pair; lang/en\|lt\|ru/forum_accessibility.php and LocalizationTest: complete key and placeholder parity for media, validation, transcript, caption, compatibility, and table text; ForumAccessibilityTest, ArchitectureComplianceTest, and ResponsiveInterfaceTest focused checkpoint: 28 tests and 22,936 assertions passed; dependency-free headless Chrome runner verified 1440x900, 375x812, and 320px reflow with one H1/main, no horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, missing image alternatives, invalid tables, undersized forum controls, or console errors; Tab exposed a visible skip-link focus ring; the browser completed administrator Livewire login, rendered media authoring controls, submitted an invalid topic form, observed focused assertive summary plus linked aria-invalid title error, and verified the authorized forum administration table caption and scoped headers; no schema migration or destructive data rewrite was introduced; existing topic IDs, URLs, answers, replies, reactions, subscriptions, bookmarks, reports, moderation history, and attachments remain under their existing relations |

| pet.interface.0004 | Pet profile and full lifecycle revision > 156 — dostupnost profilia dlia ekrannyx diktorov | vse blok i profilia dolzny imet logiceskie zagolovki i opisaniia | pet-interface | 24 | standard | implemented | verified | The additive pet migration expands the existing pet identity and adds five normalized tables with foreign keys, uniqueness, access-path indexes, optimistic versions, encrypted sensitive casts, and reversible down operations without rewriting legacy records; CreatePetProfile, PetProfileForm, and Livewire create: one private non-discoverable draft, explicit creator relationship, controlled broad species/unknown values, shared taxonomy link, stable key, creation idempotency, manager/privacy/alias creation, and actor-attributed evidence; PetProfileManager, PetManagerRole, PetProfilePermission, PetProfileAccess, policy, and invitation/revocation Actions: independent users, timed access, explicit grants/denials, server-side account/role/profile/action checks, immediate expiry/revocation, and separate critical permissions; PetProfileLifecycle and PetProfileStatus: sixteen typed states, transition validation, row and optimistic locking, state timestamps, critical-state locks, discovery side effects, idempotency, immutable actor event, and cache invalidation; PetProfileFact and RecordPetProfileFact: encrypted value/source/metadata, precision, source, author, verification, audience, immutable replacement chain, one current-key constraint, idempotent actor event, and stale-write rejection; request risk/fingerprint/repeat fields and private report idempotency are reversible; BlockSocialAccount resolves every current user, managed pet, owned expert, and owned group actor for both accounts, closes open social requests and active contact edges, invalidates both graph namespaces, applies dynamically to later profiles, and deliberately preserves pet ownership and care-manager roles; RevokeSocialAccountBlock is owner-authorized and idempotent, records immutable real-user evidence, invalidates both account graphs, and never restores ended relationships or removed requests; SocialRequestAbuseGuard normalizes and encrypts optional context, rejects contact details and repeated templates, evaluates indexed rolling and low-acceptance limits by the authenticated account, and prevents a recipient stop-repeat decision from being bypassed through another represented profile; ReportSocialRelationshipRequest accepts only the current recipient, creates one private unified ForumReport with encrypted details and an immutable request event, permanently removes the request, and can atomically block the real sender account; The Livewire request card exposes accept, decline, decline-and-prevent, account block, and structured report actions with server reauthorization, confirmation for acceptance and blocking, actor-specific accessible names, localized EN/LT/RU text, and a private outgoing block list with explicit revocation; | content.type.0003 | Content feed and distribution revision > 13 — oby cn yj tekstovyj post | avtor moz et opublikovat tekst bez obyazatelnogo media | content-types | 36 | standard | implemented | verified | Six additive content migrations create the canonical publication, audience rule and actor exceptions, interaction settings, typed domain links, independent media with reusable placement, and append-only publication event tables without replacing expert publications or legacy photo data; CreateContentPublication authorizes the authenticated real user against the represented SocialActor, requires the pet Publish permission, snapshots the representation role, rejects broad output beyond user, pet, expert, or group profile privacy, validates structured audience context, and enforces collision-safe idempotency in one transaction; ContentPublication::visibleTo, ContentAudienceCompatibility, ContentPublicationVisibility, and ContentPublicationPolicy share server-side read-time checks for published state, expiry, profile-aware broad audiences, account blocks, selected inclusions, explicit exclusions, and current follower, friend, close-circle, family, and group relationships; narrow audiences remain available to authorized viewers when a profile is not directory-discoverable; The canonical model stores a ULID, real author, publishing actor, type, text, language, status, timestamps, audience, interaction rights, media relations, domain links, and immutable event history; text publications do not require media; ContentMediaAsset stores owner, creator, media type, MIME format, byte size, processing status, safe metadata, alt text, licence, retention, checksum, and reusable publication links; tests prove private disk paths and checksums never enter rendered HTML; Thin public controllers delegate to a bounded chronological Eloquent service and presenter; fifteen rendered items from twenty publications execute no more than eleven queries with all displayed relationships eager-loaded; ContentPublicationFoundationTest passed 16 tests and 113 assertions covering schema and rollback isolation, idempotency, immutable audit, represented-pet authority, profile privacy ceilings, narrow access for current friends, every supported audience and revocation, block and expiry contraction, query bounds, factories, media and domain links, private HTML, and read-only compatibility reporting; The final serial repository suite passed 2,007 tests and 72,025 assertions in 111.278 seconds; Pint and Larastan passed with zero errors; An isolated SQLite migrate:fresh --seed completed all migrations and seeders; Composer and npm audits reported no vulnerabilities, Vite production build passed, framework caches compiled, and deterministic generation verified 22,517 requirements from the preserved source checksum; Chrome verified the content feed in English at 1440px, 375px, and 320px and in Russian with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw translation keys, or console errors |

CommunityMembershipActorEligibility and ForumGroupPolicy reload and authorize the selected actor on the server, reject foreign, inactive, group, and community-disallowed actors, and keep the real user accountable for personal, pet, and expert participation; RequestForumGroupMembership and RespondToForumGroupInvitation persist the account, selected actor, role, status, join timing, notification setting, accepted rules metadata, idempotency key, and append-only audit metadata in transactions; A single account can hold distinct personal and pet memberships in the same community; the downgrade refuses to erase this multiplicity when the old account-only uniqueness cannot represent it; SocialActorResolver bulk-provisions missing pet actors and settings and returns a bounded eager-loaded profile set; the 25-pet regression stays within twenty queries instead of adding per-pet actor and settings queries; The Livewire workspace exposes only the selected actor UUID as public state, resolves authority again for each action, clearly shows the selected profile, accepted rules version, and real-account accountability notice, and provides EN, LT, and RU platform text; A single account can hold distinct personal and pet memberships in the same community; the downgrade refuses to erase this multiplicity when the old account-only uniqueness cannot represent it; SocialActorResolver bulk-provisions missing pet actors and settings and returns a bounded eager-loaded profile set; the 25-pet regression stays within twenty queries instead of adding per-pet actor and settings queries; The Livewire workspace exposes only the selected actor UUID as public state, resolves authority again for each action, clearly shows the selected profile, accepted rules version, and real-account accountability notice, and provides EN, LT, and RU platform text; CommunityProfileMembershipTest passed 8 tests and 38 assertions; the related social and content set passed 52 tests and 736 assertions; the final clean serial repository suite passed 2,015 tests and 72,245 assertions; Larastan and Pint passed, isolated SQLite migrate:fresh --seed and default migrate and seed passed, Composer and npm audits reported no vulnerabilities, Vite built successfully, and Laravel configuration, event, route, view, and icon caches compiled; Chrome verified the community workspace at 1440px and 375px and in Russian with one H1 and main, zero overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw translation keys, undersized touch targets, or console errors; the English profile selector exposed three eligible profiles |

CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; the explicit no-known-items state and freshness label were visible |

| medical.access-consent.0022 | Medical record and full clinical history revision > 37 — sovladelec | sovladelec moz et poluchit poln yj ili ogranichenn yj dostup | medical-access-consent | 65 | critical | implemented | verified | The additive migration links each medical record to a canonical PetProfile through an indexed unique foreign key, deterministically backfills unambiguous legacy records, preserves historical owner snapshots, and keeps ambiguous legacy rows usable within their old access boundary; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; the explicit no-known-items state and freshness label were visible |

| medical.access-consent.0174 | Medical record and full clinical history revision > 47 — razdelenie prosmotra i redaktirovanija | poluchatel moz et imet pravo prosmatra bez prava izmeniat dannye | medical-access-consent | 65 | critical | implemented | verified | The additive migration links each medical record to a canonical PetProfile through an indexed unique foreign key, deterministically backfills unambiguous legacy records, preserves historical owner snapshots, and keeps ambiguous legacy rows usable within their old access boundary; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; the explicit no-known-items state and freshness label were visible |

CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; | medical.interface-quality-release.0254 | Medical record and full clinical history revision > 268 — obyazatelnye funkcii dostup a | osnovnogo xoziajina | medical-interface-quality-release | 72 | standard | implemented | verified | The additive migration links each medical record to a canonical PetProfile through an indexed unique foreign key, deterministically backfills unambiguous legacy records, preserves historical owner snapshots, and keeps ambiguous legacy rows usable within their old access boundary; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; the explicit no-known-items state and freshness label were visible |

| medical.interface-quality-release.0277 | Medical record and full clinical history revision > 269 — obyazatelnye funkcii nadezhnosti | idempotentnost | medical-interface-quality-release | 72 | standard | implemented | verified | The additive migration links each medical record to a canonical PetProfile through an indexed unique foreign key, deterministically backfills unambiguous legacy records, preserves historical owner snapshots, and keeps ambiguous legacy rows usable within their old access boundary; CreateMedicalRecord reloads the selected persistent pet, authorizes manage-medical on the server, derives identity and current ownership from that pet, refuses a second canonical record, stores a private record, and records an audit event; MedicalRecordPolicy and the accessibleTo Eloquent scope derive current access from the canonical pet owner or an active manager role; transfer tests prove that the former owner immediately loses visibility while the new owner retains the same medical history; Co-owner, foster-carer, specialist expiry, explicit permission overrides, and view-versus-manage checks provide least-privilege server authorization without trusting historical owner keys or browser state; MedicalKnowledgeStatus separates unknown, not provided, no known items in the available history, and known information for allergies and current medicines; the create, detail, shared, and emergency views render the state in EN, LT, and RU instead of interpreting an empty list as proof of absence; The existing temporary-access workflow keeps tokens hashed, scopes a grant to selected sections, expiry, view count, and download permission, audits opening and download, and makes the same URL unusable immediately after revocation; Medical documents remain on private storage, record source and review status, require an authorized download action, and increment an audited download count; Medication-dose submission uses an idempotency key and a unique medication slot so repeated requests create one administration fact and one audit event; MedicalRecordTest passed 15 tests and 120 assertions; MedicalRecordTest together with ArchitectureComplianceTest passed 35 tests and 26,307 assertions; the final serial repository suite passed 2,027 tests and 72,581 assertions; SQLite migrate:fresh with demo seeding passed; the additive migration also passed rollback, reapply, and deterministic demo reconciliation without creating duplicate records; Pint, Larastan, Composer validation and audit, npm audit, Vite production build, Laravel caches, deterministic source preservation, and deterministic requirement generation passed; The CDP browser harness verified the medical directory, creation, detail, management, and emergency card at 1440px, 375px, and 320px with one H1 and main, zero horizontal overflow, unnamed controls, duplicate IDs, invalid images, raw medical translation keys, or console errors; the explicit no-known-items state and freshness label were visible |
